description: Template. Copy to eval/recall.local.json (gitignored) or pass --config / VC_EVAL_RECALL. 'basic' = facts the assistant echoed in its own text (a summary can keep them); 'hard' = facts that appeared ONLY in a tool result (pick them with `npm run eval:offline -- --facts <session.jsonl>` and confirm they are absent from every assistant text) - only verbatim retention answers those. Tokens match case-insensitively as substrings of the answer.

sets.name: basic
sets.question: Without using any tools, answer from this conversation only, one short line each: (1) ... Say 'unknown' for anything you cannot recall.

sets.name: hard
sets.question: Without using any tools, answer from this conversation only, one short line each: (1) in the <command> output near the start, which <value> ...? Say 'unknown' for anything you cannot recall.
